title: cdp-smoke-test
desc: CDP command smoke test: 10 subcommands in ~15s, reports PASS/FAIL
steps: TESTS: open --new-window, url, title, navigate, html, status, fetch, tabs, open-reuse, close
FAIL GUIDE: url-title empty=stdout bug. wrong tab=domain grap. open hangs=zombie Chrome

BASELINE: Before smoke test, run wkcdp-mon to establish baseline: record [PORT] [MEM] [LAT(avg)] for each session. After test, compare: (1) MEM growth > 100M/session = memory leak, (2) LAT spike > 50ms avg = performance regression, (3) DRIFT change = position handling issue, (4) extra procs in Get-Process chrome = zombie accumulation. wkcdp-mon baseline → test → post-test wkcdp-mon = complete health diagnostic.
author: claude
